meta.title: Only the person who submitted the award can withdraw it, and must give a reason
gaps: Open the proposal separately as the submitter and a colleague.
Assert that the Withdraw Proposal menu is present only for the submitter.
Open Withdraw Request and verify it is disabled when the reason is empty.
Enter a reason and submit the withdrawal.
Assert the success toast and redirect.
Assert the resulting banner contains the submitter name and date.
